title: FUMI Minty Blueberry Nicotine Pouches - 8mg per Pouch
description: FUMi Minty Blueberry Strong Nicotine Pouches combine juicy Blueberry with a refreshing Mint note for a pouch that’s sweet, cool and easy to enjoy. The balance of flavour makes it a solid everyday option for those who like a fruit-and-mint combination. Each slim, all-white pouch sits discreetly under the lip and delivers 8mg of nicotine gradually over up to 30 minutes. With no smoke, vapour or odour, FUMi pouches are ideal for use at home, at work or while out and about. Each can contains 20 plant-fibre pouches, crafted in Sweden by Helix AB. Nicotine Range: Strong - 8mg this is suited for more experienced users. How to Use Nicotine Pouches: Please Note: DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH
